title: Great fun and amazing photographer
text: This was loads of fun! Val was wonderful and we had a  great time doing the shots. She is an amazing photographer and I just received the photos. I had expected to just get a few but the price includes 25 high quality photos to download. All of them are stunning! I highly recommend and will definitely do more when I return to Barcelona.
author: Dawn_J

title: Fabulous Photo Experience in Barcelona!
text: We are so happy to work with Val on our Barcelona Park Guell Tour!  It was our little girl's first international trip at 10 months old, so we knew that we had limited time before the baby would crash. Val got us to all the picturesque sites and knew where we should pose to get the best shots.  We have wonderful pictures, and baby was smiling from start to finish!   Can't recommend this enough
author: 104theresav

title: The Perfect Birthday Trip Souvenir
text: I was visiting Barcelona with my younger sister and had a vision of living out my Cheetah Girls 2 fantasy for my birthday photoshoot. My photographer/guide Nati was so thoughtful, warm, and kind! This was my first time booking a photographer for travel and I will now be incorporating a similar experience into all of my future trips. title: Effortless, Comfortable, and Stunning Results!
text: Absolutely loved this photoshoot experience — hands down the easiest photoshoot I’ve ever done. The photographer made me feel completely comfortable from the start and had a great eye for locations. I’m beyond happy with how everything turned out. 10/10 would book again!
